diagnosis: the bottleneck is not parameter count but a rugged, multimodal likelihood from structural misfit: the 2D Epileptor + linear log-power observation map cannot reproduce the 6D-generated PC1 time course (per-PC noise sigma_1 ~4x baseline at every optimum); every L-BFGS start (96/96) and every Pathfinder path (32/32) ends in a different optimum; EZ vs PZ separation is 2-4 nats in profile. Pinning z_init and restricting the free set did not remove the EZ/PZ ambiguity.
recommendation: do not use v3 for patient fitting. Next: (1) a nonlinear observation model for log power (log of gain^2-weighted source power plus noise floor) or fit generator-consistent features; (2) a time-scale parameter for the fast subsystem or nsub chosen from the data's onset rise time; (3) tempering / SMC or per-mode reporting instead of single-run NUTS; (4) the LEAD's stimulation paradigm (prespecified in the task log) before P2 transfer.
